description: This file implements the SeoUrl class in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles SEO URL rewriting and parsing, including translating URLs to internal routes and vice versa. The class works with models for SEO URLs and regex patterns, and modifies request parameters accordingly.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling SEO-friendly URL rewriting and decoding within OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to decode incoming SEO URLs and map them to internal routes, as well as handling URL rewriting logic.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Converts a standard URL into an SEO-friendly URL by replacing query parameters with SEO keywords based on regex patterns and SEO URL mappings.
